ACT IX OF 2023
PUNJAB FINANCE (AMENDMENT) ACT, 2023
An Act to amend the Punjab Finance Act, 2014
[Gazette of Punjab Extraordinary, 17th February,
2023]
No. PAP/Legis-2(136)/2021/102, dated 17.2.2023.---The Punjab Finance (Amendment) Bill 2021, having
been passed by the Provincial Assembly of the Punjab on the 9th day of January
2023, and assented to by the Governor of the Punjab on the 23rd day of January
2023, is hereby published as an Act of the Provincial Assembly of the Punjab.
It is necessary to amend the Punjab Finance Act
2014 (XVII of 2014) for purposes hereinafter appearing.
Be it enacted by Provincial Assembly of the Punjab
as follows:
1. Short title
and commencement.---(1) This Act
may be cited as the Punjab Finance (Amendment) Act, 2023.
(2) This Act
shall come into force at once.

Amendment of section 8 of Act XVII of 2014

Be it enacted by Provincial Assembly of the Punjab
as follows:
2. Amendment
of section 8 of Act XVII of 2014.---In
the Punjab Finance Act 2014 (XVII of 2014), hereinafter referred to as 'the
Act', in section 8, in subsection (12), for the word "Government",
the expression "Additional Director General, Excise and Taxation, Punjab"
shall be substituted.
